summary: John's 10th-great-grandfather (speculative); of Oberbrombach, Birkenfeld district. His parents Hanns Grub and Elsa would be 11th-great-grandparents.
bio: Christmann Grub of Oberbrombach and his wife Margaretha were parents of Caspar Grub (b. 1616); through them the file reaches Hanns Grub and Elsa. The file's death year 'about 1933' is a typo, probably for 1633.
sources: GEDBAS file 53093 ('Helf-Maier', compiled by Karl-Hans Helf; Jettenbach Grubs; Lutheran parish; sources not displayed), person 1193191900: https://gedbas.genealogy.net/person/show/1193191900
